## Install

Install the APK, enable the module, and scope it to **System UI**. Pixel Fold users must also select **Pixel Launcher**. Reboot once, then verify that ordinary presses animate and a long press still launches Circle to Search.

## Checksums

- `PixelPill-Motion-vX.Y.Z.apk`: `SHA-256`
- `PixelPill-Motion-vX.Y.Z-source.zip`: `SHA-256`

## Safety note

If SystemUI is unstable, disable the module in Vector/LSPosed and reboot. Please attach the framework log lines tagged `PixelPillMotion` when reporting compatibility issues.
